Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications – 100 Litre Oil Stirrer An Oil Stirrer is an essential piece of equipment used in Ayurvedic medicine ma nufacturing for the continuous stirring and mixing of oils during the preparation of medicated oils (Thailam). It ensures uniform distribution of herbal ingredients and active constituents throughout the oil, promotes effective heat transfer duri ng heating, and helps prevent the settling of solid particles and localized overhe ating. The equipment is particularly useful during the preparation of Ayurvedic f ormulations involving the processing of herbal pastes, decoctions, and oils unde r controlled temperature and time conditions. It should be constructed from suit able, corrosion-resistant materials, preferably stainless steel, to maintain produ ct quality, ensure hygienic processing, and facilitate easy cleaning and mainten ance. Type: Slow-speed industrial oil stirrer suitable for Ayurvedic Taila preparation. Capacity: 100 litres. Motor Power: 10 HP. Tank Material: Stainless Steel SS 304. Tank Capacity: 100 litres. Stirring Mechanism: Slow-speed stirring arrangement suitable for uniform mixin

g of medicated oils. Leg Height: 2 feet. Outlet Valve: 1-inch valve. Tilting Mechanism: The oil pan shall be mounted on a tilting mechanism to allow it to rotate about its axis f or easy discharge of prepared oil. Side Discharge Valve: A valve shall be provided on the side of the pan for convenient removal of the prepa red oil. leaning Facility: The pan shall be designed to facilitate easy cleaning with water. Bottom Drain Outlet: A separate outlet shall be provided at the bottom of the pan to drain cleaning water c ompletely after washing. Hygienic Design: The internal surface of the pan shall be smooth and easy to clean to minimize residue acc umulation and cross-contamination. Corrosion Resistance: All product-contact surfaces shall be corrosion-resistant and suitable for contact with medicinal oils and herbal ingredients. Operational Safety: The tilting mechanism shall provide stable, controlled movement and safe handling du ring discharge and cleaning. Ease of Maintenance: The equipment shall be designed for convenient inspection, cleaning, and routine m aintenance. Electrical Supply: Three-phase power supply. Control Panel: Suitable electrical panel board with starter. Installation: Complete installation, assembly and commissioning at the purchas er’s premises. Demonstration: The supplier shall demonstrate the equipment’s operation and s atisfactory working after installation. Criteria’s: Installation: Complete installation, commissioning, and demonstration of workin g shall be carried out by the supplier. Transportation: Transportation, loading, unloading, and delivery to the purchase r's premises shall be the supplier's responsibility. Warranty: Minimum one-year warranty from the date of successful installation a nd commissioning. After-Sales Service: The supplier shall provide service support within Kerala. Operational Demonstration: The supplier shall demonstrate the machine's perfo rmance at the specified capacity during commissioning. .
